summary: Established the single-activity worker, Python authority, CPython 3.12.13, uv/uv.lock, testing, ADR and evidence contract. Corrected stale handoff policy to the existing local build/mvp promotion with push disabled. Recorded tool observations and bounded future launch policy without launching a worker. No model mechanism was implemented or removed.
reviewer: Assigned AE-001 Codex worker (author self-review; no independent reviewer or human participant)
review_notes: Read the campaign sections 2–8 and AE-001, assumptions, PaymentCo brief, ADR register/template and handoff. AE-001 has no predecessors in either campaign source, so no missing predecessor gate is bypassed. Walked the fresh-worker path to queue scope, exact commands, receipt and import boundary. Reviewed actual system/controller/project runtime differences, successful inspect/render output, missing Godot PATH results, and controller source separation of launch from promotion. Reconciled obsolete handoff claims without changing configuration/checker. ADR-001 accepts only the existing product constraint; aggregate/transport architecture and future import tests remain unaccepted or unverified. See research/experiments/AE-001/review.md for counterexamples and limitations. Independent controller validation remains subsequent work, not an asserted result.
limitations: Review is worker self-review, not independent domain review or human acceptance; no model-router reviewer is configured.
Initial activity-evidence validation failed because AE-001.json did not exist. That actual baseline failure is retained in observations.json; it is not a behavioral TDD red result.
godot and godot4 were not found on the inspected PATH. Other installation locations were not searched and no Godot installation or test was attempted.
CPython 3.12.13 is a selected execution baseline, not proof of deterministic simulation or compatibility with system Python 3.14.4 or another runtime.
Project pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .venv, package and tests do not exist yet. AE-003 owns bootstrap and dependency installation; future uv sync and pytest commands were not run.
No simulation, import-boundary, replay, Godot, empirical calibration or actual participant evidence exists from this task. MVP completion is unsupported.

Only controller inspection, rendering and run help were executed. Future launch behavior was reviewed in source, not exercised; external state database and integration/publication outcomes were not inspected.
Historical planning receipt statements about pending queues and dry-run promotion are retained as historical findings; the updated handoff reflects the committed manifest without modifying it.

The requested local commit was not created: git add exited 128 because the linked worktree index is outside writable roots on a read-only filesystem. Source files are complete but uncommitted; controller/operator recovery with authorized Git metadata access is required before integration or successor use.

tdd.reason: Documentation and evidence only; no behavioral implementation or new prose-mirroring tests.
